concept: A tender mending retreat where blankets, warm light, and a few careful repair tools make difficult days feel softer.
floor: One broad continuous muted-mauve felt floor across the full top face, divided into only four to six oversized softly joined cushion panels without stitching, patches, rugs, or a separate path.
main_structure: One broad open-front cream-and-lavender blanket alcove at the rear with a rounded canopy, one oversized folded blanket, and one large candle-heart lamp set into the back wall.
rear_props: one broad low mending table with one oversized spool, one folded cloth, and one simple bandage roll
two large warm cream lanterns flanking the rear alcove
side_props: one chunky cushioned armchair and one broad closed keepsake box on the upper-left edge
one simple blanket chest and one oversized rounded mint planter on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous smooth upholstered lavender border with broad cream capstones
perimeter.emblems: four oversized simple heart-patch and bandage emblems

materials: a few broad soft-mint stone blocks

lighting: soft calm evening light from one large candle-heart glow and two broad warm lantern pools
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open muted-mauve felt floor
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature, person, or egg baked into the bitmap
center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, readable labels, text, watermark, external shadow
tiny stitches, fabric fibers, loose thread, tiny tools, flowers, grass blades, pebbles, cracks, specks, or dense clutter
